name: jevc
description: One skill, /jevc:jevc, that turns a rule from CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or a skill into narrow typed Jev questions with the verdict computed in code, and optionally installs the result as a project's PreToolUse gate after asking. It runs the jevc CLI (npm: jev-compiler) through npx if it is not installed. No hooks: the gate is registered per project, never by the plugin.
